'''Vampiric Link''' is a [[Link skill]] that targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration.  While linked, they get recovery from your life leech instead of you. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
